definitions.explanation: The degree to which a person, brand, place, or thing is known by the general public.

examples.japanese: {知名度|ちめいど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧だ。
SNS⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{知名度|ちめいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to social media, name recognition went up.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{知名度|ちめいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧だ。
examples.english: This region has abundant tourist resources, but low name recognition remains a challenge.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (high) or ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (low) to describe the level of recognition. Also pairs with verbs like ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (to rise), ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to raise), and ⟦{広|ひろ}まる→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧ (to spread). Common in marketing, media, and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {知名度|ちめいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: well-known, famous
- {知名度|ちめいど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: not well-known
- {知名度|ちめいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to raise name recognition
- {知名度|ちめいど}⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧: outstanding name recognition
- ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}{的|てき}→全国的：20017_zenkokuteki⟧な{知名度|ちめいど}: nationwide recognition
